before_sql:
SELECT s.semester_id, s.semester_term, s.semester_year
FROM Semesters AS s
JOIN Student_Enrolment AS se ON se.semester_id = s.semester_id
JOIN Degree_Programs AS dp ON dp.degree_program_id = se.degree_program_id
GROUP BY s.semester_id, s.semester_term, s.semester_year
HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN dp.is_master = 'T' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN dp.is_bachelor = 'T' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1;
after_sql:
SELECT s.semester_id
FROM Semesters AS s
JOIN Student_Enrolment AS se ON se.semester_id = s.semester_id
JOIN Degree_Programs AS dp ON dp.degree_program_id = se.degree_program_id
GROUP BY s.semester_id, s.semester_term, s.semester_year
HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN dp.is_master = 'T' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN dp.is_bachelor = 'T' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1;

before_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.semester_id, s.semester_term, s.semester_year
FROM "Semesters" AS s
JOIN "Student_Enrolment" AS se ON se.semester_id = s.semester_id
JOIN "Degree_Programs" AS dp ON dp.degree_program_id = se.degree_program_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "Student_Enrolment" AS se_master
    JOIN "Degree_Programs" AS dp_master
        ON dp_master.degree_program_id = se_master.degree_program_id
    WHERE se_master.semester_id = s.semester_id
      AND dp_master.is_master = 'T'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "Student_Enrolment" AS se_bachelor
    JOIN "Degree_Programs" AS dp_bachelor
        ON dp_bachelor.degree_program_id = se_bachelor.degree_program_id
    WHERE se_bachelor.semester_id = s.semester_id
      AND dp_bachelor.is_bachelor = 'T'
);
after_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.semester_id
FROM "Semesters" AS s
JOIN "Student_Enrolment" AS se ON se.semester_id = s.semester_id
JOIN "Degree_Programs" AS dp ON dp.degree_program_id = se.degree_program_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "Student_Enrolment" AS se_master
    JOIN "Degree_Programs" AS dp_master
        ON dp_master.degree_program_id = se_master.degree_program_id
    WHERE se_master.semester_id = s.semester_id
      AND dp_master.is_master = 'T'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "Student_Enrolment" AS se_bachelor
    JOIN "Degree_Programs" AS dp_bachelor
        ON dp_bachelor.degree_program_id = se_bachelor.degree_program_id
    WHERE se_bachelor.semester_id = s.semester_id
      AND dp_bachelor.is_bachelor = 'T'
);

WHERE is_winner_right_handed = 'F'
  AND tourney_name = 'WTA Championships';
after_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT winner_name)
FROM matches
WHERE is_winner_right_handed = 'F'
  AND tourney_name = 'WTA Championships';

after_sql:

FROM matches
